description: Defines an immutable data class 'LoanSchedulePeriodData' representing a period in a loan schedule, including various financial metrics and static factory methods for creating instances for specific period types.

classes.name: LoanSchedulePeriodData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a period of a loan schedule with various financial attributes and static factory methods.

methods.name: disbursementOnlyPeriod
methods.description: Creates a period data object for a disbursement-only period, setting relevant financial fields based on disbursement details.

methods.name: repaymentOnlyPeriod
methods.description: Creates a period data object for a repayment-only period, calculating totals based on principal, interest, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: downPaymentOnlyPeriod
methods.description: Creates a period data object for a down payment period with specified principal and outstanding balance.

methods.name: periodWithPayments
methods.description: Creates a detailed period data object including payment details, obligations met, and various financial metrics.

methods.name: withPaidDetail
methods.description: Returns a new period data object with updated payment details and recalculated outstanding amounts.
